title: DUS Mortgage Loans Term Sheet
notes: Product overview identifies conventional properties in permanent DUS financing. No advertised term is treated as an eligibility rule.

title: Contact Multifamily, Borrower Support
notes: Describes purchases from Optigo lenders. Numeric eligibility criteria are out of scope.

title: Multifamily Seller/Servicer Guide, Chapter 22, Originating a Manufactured Housing Community Mortgage
notes: Official Guide index linked the PDF marked Guide Bulletin Update April 22, 2025. Sections 22.1, 22.5 and 22.10–22.13 cover definitions, appraisal, title and applicable security-interest issues. No borrowing cap or current numeric eligibility conclusion.

title: Taking Stock of Your Water System: A Simple Asset Inventory for Very Small Drinking Water Systems
notes: Includes manufactured home communities and supports inventory and condition review of wells, pumps, lines, valves and related assets. Does not establish permitting requirements for a particular property.

title: About Small Wastewater Systems
notes: Distinguishes centralized sewers and on-site or clustered wastewater treatment. Actual system obligations depend on the operator, applicable law and permits.

title: Manufactured Housing Finance: New Insights from the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act
notes: Supports the distinction between personal-property and real-property titling of manufactured homes. Research concerns consumer home financing, not commercial MHC underwriting.

title: Multifamily Selling and Servicing Guide, Part III, Chapter 6, Section 603, Legal and Property Compliance
notes: June 2, 2026 edition, especially sections 603.01B–C and 603.05. Covers the collateral description, utilities and site lease protections in this execution. The live edition and Section 606 income treatment should be confirmed for a specific loan.

title: 26 U.S.C. §42, Low-Income Housing Credit
publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
notes: Subsections (g)(2), (f), (h)(6) and (i)(1) support gross rent, credit, extended use and compliance distinctions. Check building-specific applicability, elections, amendments and recorded agreements.

title: 26 CFR §1.42-5, Monitoring Compliance with Low-Income Housing Credit Requirements
publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, via eCFR
notes: Recordkeeping, certification, review and inspections. Confirm exceptions, agency monitoring procedures and other overlapping requirements for each property.

title: RAD Project-Based Vouchers vs. Project-Based Rental Assistance Comparison Guide
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: April 2025 guide. Used for the distinction between the PBV and PBRA contracting structures and the difference between a project contract and tenant-based voucher assistance. RAD-specific terms and renewal requirements are not generalized.

title: Optigo Targeted Affordable Housing Term Sheets
notes: Confirms the existence of dedicated affordable housing financing options. Product selection and eligibility require the applicable chapter and specific transaction documents.

title: Multifamily Financing Options
notes: Identifies affordable multifamily debt and LIHTC equity offerings as separate channels. No program terms are inferred.

title: Office of Multifamily Housing Production
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: Describes HUD oversight of FHA multifamily mortgage insurance. Specific insurance criteria are outside the draft.
